title.zh: 卷264 列傳五十一 郝维讷 任克溥 刘鸿儒 刘楗 张廷枢
title.en: Volume 264 Biographies 51: Hao Weine, Ren Kepu, Liu Hongru, Liu Jian, Zhang Tingshu
title.raw: 卷264 列傳五十一 郝维讷 任克溥 刘鸿儒 刘楗 张廷枢

sentences.zh: 郝維訥，字敏公，直隸霸州人。

translations.literal: Hao Weine, styled Mingong, was a native of Bazhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Weine, whose courtesy name was Mingong, came from Bazhou in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 父傑，明崇禎進士。

translations.literal: His father Jie was a jinshi of the Chongzhen reign of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jie had passed the jinshi examination in the Chongzhen era of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 順治初，授行人，遷戶部給事中。

translations.literal: In the early Shunzhi period, he was appointed Bearer, then promoted to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shunzhi reign he was made a Bearer and later promoted to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 迭疏請開經筵，祀闕里，廢斥諸臣才堪錄用者量予自新，朝賀大典內監不得入班行禮，俱下部議行。

translations.literal: In memorial after memorial he requested that the imperial lecture be opened, that sacrifices be performed at Qufu, that dismissed officials whose talents were fit for employment be given reinstatement as appropriate, and that eunuchs not be allowed to join the ranks at grand court ceremonies — all referred to the relevant ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He sent repeated memorials asking that the emperor resume the lecture series, that sacrifices be offered at Qufu, that dismissed officials still fit for service be allowed to rehabilitate themselves as appropriate, and that eunuchs be barred from joining the ceremonial ranks at great court audiences; each proposal was sent to the appropriate ministry for deliberation and execution.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He passed away.

sentences.zh: 維訥，順治四年進士，授刑部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: Weine passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Shunzhi, was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and was twice promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Weine took his jinshi degree in the fourth year of Shunzhi, entered the Ministry of Punishments as a clerk, and was promoted twice to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 七年，出為福建督糧道僉事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he went out as junior vice commissioner of the grain-supervision circuit in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was posted abroad as junior vice commissioner on Fujian's grain-supervision circuit.

sentences.zh: 師下漳南，糧運多阻，維訥督米二萬石浮海達泉州以濟軍。

translations.literal: When the army descended on southern Zhangzhou, grain transport was largely blocked; Weine supervised twenty thousand shi of rice, sent it by sea to Quanzhou, and relieved the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the army marched into southern Zhangzhou, grain shipments were largely cut off; Weine oversaw twenty thousand shi of rice, floated it by sea to Quanzhou, and supplied the troops.

sentences.zh: 巨盜張自盛犯延、卲，徙維訥權延建卲道，設方略，用間散其黨，自盛就擒。

translations.literal: The great bandit Zhang Zisheng raided Yan and Shao; Weine was transferred to act as commissioner of the Yan-Jian-Shao circuit, devised stratagems, used agents to break up his band, and Zisheng was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The great outlaw Zhang Zisheng harried Yanzhou and Shaowu; Weine was moved to act as commissioner of the Yan-Jian-Shao circuit, laid plans, sent agents to break up Zhang's following, and Zhang was taken.

sentences.zh: 尋署按察使，謝苞苴，絕羨耗。

translations.literal: Soon after he was acting provincial judge; he declined gifts and stopped embezzling surcharges.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting provincial judge, refusing gifts and putting an end to embezzled surcharges.

sentences.zh: 舉卓異，復用孫承澤、成克鞏薦，十一年，召授通政司右參議。

translations.literal: Rated outstanding, he was again recommended by Sun Chengze and Cheng Kegong; in the eleventh year he was summoned and appointed right vice commissioner of the Communications Office.
translations.idiomatic: Marked out as outstanding, he was recommended again on the nominations of Sun Chengze and Cheng Kegong; in the eleventh year he was recalled to the capital and made right vice commissioner of the Communications Office.

sentences.zh: 累遷大理寺卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to president of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He rose by stages to president of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢戶部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to vice minister of revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was elevated to vice minister of revenue and then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十六年，丁父憂。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he mourned his father.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he entered mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起戶部侍郎，復調吏部。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was recalled as vice minister of revenue and again transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning was over he was recalled as vice minister of revenue and once more transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，典會試，尋擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he oversaw the metropolitan examination and soon after was promoted to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he presided over the metropolitan examination and was soon promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 維訥以開國二十餘年，南徼初定，民困未蘇，疏言：「天下大弊在民窮財盡，連年川、湖、閩、廣、雲、貴無不增兵增餉，本省不支，他省協濟。

translations.literal: Weine observed that more than twenty years after the founding, the southern frontiers had only just been pacified and the people had not yet recovered from hardship. He memorialized: "The great ill of the realm lies in the people's poverty and the exhaustion of revenue. Year after year in Sichuan, Huguang, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Guizhou troops and supplies have been increased without cease; the province itself could not support them and other provinces were levied to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Weine reasoned that more than twenty years after the founding of the dynasty the southern marches had only just been settled and the people had not yet recovered from distress. He memorialized: "The gravest evil in the realm is that the people are impoverished and the treasury drained. Year after year in Sichuan, Huguang, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Guizhou there have been endless increases in troops and supplies; the home province could not bear the cost and other provinces were called on to help.

sentences.zh: 臣觀川、湖等省尚多曠土，若選綠旗及降兵精銳者隸之營伍，給以牛種，所在屯田，則供應減而協濟可以永除，閭里無追呼之困。

translations.literal: Your servant has observed that in Sichuan, Huguang, and other provinces there is still much vacant land. If select Green Standard troops and surrendered soldiers of the finest quality were organized into companies and given oxen and seed for garrison farming wherever they were stationed, then local supply would diminish and mutual aid levies from other provinces could be abolished forever, and neighborhoods would be freed from the distress of forced collection."
translations.idiomatic: I have seen that Sichuan, Huguang, and the like still hold much unused land. If the best of the Green Standard troops and surrendered soldiers were formed into companies, given oxen and seed, and set to garrison farming wherever they were posted, local supply would shrink, aid levies from other provinces could be ended for good, and villages would no longer suffer the torment of press-gangs."

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「巡按既裁，地方巡視責歸督撫。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Now that touring inspectors have been abolished, the duty of local inspection falls to governors-general and governors.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Since touring inspectors have been abolished, the responsibility for inspecting the provinces rests with governors-general and governors.

sentences.zh: 督撫任重事繁，出巡動逾旬月，恐誤公務，況騎從眾多，經過滋擾。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors bear heavy responsibilities and many duties; when they go on inspection tours it often takes more than ten days, which may cause official business to be neglected; moreover their large retinues cause increasing disturbance wherever they pass.
translations.idiomatic: Their duties are weighty and their business abundant; an inspection tour often lasts more than a month, official affairs may be neglected, and their large mounted retinues disturb every place they pass through.

sentences.zh: 至屬官貪廉，閭閻疾苦，諮訪耳目，仍寄司道。

translations.literal: As for the probity or corruption of subordinate officials and the hardships of the people, inquiry and intelligence still depend on the circuit intendant and prefectural commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: As for whether subordinates are greedy or honest and what hardships the people endure, inquiry and intelligence still depend on the circuit and prefectural commissioners.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後事關重大者，仍親身巡察，餘概停止。

translations.literal: Henceforth only matters of great moment should be inspected in person; all the rest should cease entirely."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereafter they inspect in person only what is truly grave and cease touring altogether in other cases."

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「山西、山東等省偏旱，發帑賑濟，聖恩至為優渥，特窮鄉僻壤恐難遍及，惟蠲免錢糧，率土均霑實惠。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Shanxi, Shandong, and other provinces have suffered partial drought. The disbursement of treasury funds for relief has been most generous in imperial grace, yet remote villages and secluded districts may be hard to reach comprehensively; only the remission of land tax and grain levies lets the benefit spread equally throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Shanxi, Shandong, and other provinces have suffered localized drought. Imperial relief from the treasury has been extraordinarily generous, yet remote hamlets may still be hard to reach; only remission of taxes and grain dues spreads the real benefit across the whole realm.

sentences.zh: 但田有田賦，丁有丁差，前者被災地方，例多免糧不免丁；

translations.literal: But land has land tax and persons have poll tax; in places stricken by disaster, precedent usually remits grain but not poll tax;
translations.idiomatic: Yet land bears land tax and persons bear poll tax; in disaster areas precedent usually remits grain but not poll dues;

sentences.zh: 其有丁無田者，反不得與有田之戶同霑恩澤。

translations.literal: those who have poll tax obligations but no land cannot share the imperial favor equally with landholding households.
translations.idiomatic: those liable for poll tax but owning no land cannot share the imperial favor equally with landholding households.

sentences.zh: 請丁銀均如田糧分數蠲免。

translations.literal: I request that poll silver be remitted in the same proportion as land grain."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that poll silver be remitted in the same proportion as land grain."

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「貪吏罪至死者，遇赦免死，並免交吏部議處。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Corrupt officials whose crime warrants death, when pardoned, escape execution and also escape referral to the Ministry of Personnel for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Corrupt officials whose crimes merit death, when pardoned, escape execution and are also spared referral to the Ministry of Personnel for disposition.

sentences.zh: 此曹饕餮狼藉，未可令其復玷名器，貽害地方。

translations.literal: These men have gorged and littered the office; they must not be allowed again to defile official rank and harm the locality.
translations.idiomatic: Such men have gorged themselves and left ruin in their wake; they must not be allowed again to stain official rank and harm the regions they govern.

sentences.zh: 雖新例赴部另補，貪殘所至，播虐惟均。

translations.literal: Though the new regulation sends them to the ministry for reassignment, wherever the greedy and cruel go, their ravages are equally spread.
translations.idiomatic: Though the new rule sends them to the ministry for reassignment, wherever the greedy and cruel go they spread misery alike.

sentences.zh: 請敕部定議，凡贓款審實者，遇赦免罪，仍當奪官。

translations.literal: I request an order to the ministry to establish a rule: whenever embezzled funds are proved on investigation, even if pardon remits the crime, office must still be stripped.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry be ordered to fix a rule: whenever embezzled sums are proved on investigation, even if a pardon remits the crime, office must still be taken away.

sentences.zh: 庶官箴可肅，民害可除。

translations.literal: Thus official discipline may be enforced and harm to the people removed.
translations.idiomatic: Then official discipline may be restored and harm to the people ended.

sentences.zh: 」皆下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All these proposals were sent to the ministries for deliberation and execution.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷工部尚書，調刑、禮二部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to minister of Works, then to the ministries of Punishments and Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was moved to minister of Works, then to the ministries of Punishments and Rites.

sentences.zh: 八年，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During the eighth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疏請停督撫勘災，申禁圈取民地，並得旨允行。

translations.literal: He memorialized to stop governors-general and governors from inspecting disaster areas, and to forbid the seizure of commoners' land for enclosures — both received imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to end governors' disaster inspections and to forbid the enclosure of commoners' land; both measures received imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: During the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時兵興開捐納，正途日壅，維訥為斟酌資格，按缺分選，銓法稱平。

translations.literal: At the time war had begun and purchase of office by contribution was opened, blocking the regular path of advancement daily; Weine weighed qualifications and assigned posts by vacancy category, and the appointment system was called fair.
translations.idiomatic: War was underway and the sale of offices by contribution had opened, choking the regular route of promotion day by day; Weine weighed qualifications and assigned posts by vacancy type, and the appointment system was praised as even-handed.

sentences.zh: 十八年，給事中姚締虞請寬免科道風聞言事之禁，下廷臣議，維訥謂：「言官奏事，原不禁其風聞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the supervising secretary Yao Diyu requested loosening the ban on censors reporting on hearsay; the matter was sent to court officials for discussion. Weine said: "Memorials by remonstrance officials were never forbidden from hearsay in the first place.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year supervising secretary Yao Diyu asked that the ban on censors' reporting on hearsay be relaxed; the matter was sent to court officials for discussion. Weine said: "Censors were never forbidden to base memorials on hearsay in the first place.

sentences.zh: 但風聞奏參審問全虛者，例有處分，否則慮有藉風聞挾私報怨者，請仍照定例行。

translations.literal: But where impeachment on hearsay is investigated and found wholly false, there is precedent for punishment; otherwise one fears some will use hearsay to pursue private revenge — I request that the established rule still be followed."
translations.idiomatic: But when impeachment on hearsay is investigated and proves wholly false, there is precedent for punishment; otherwise some will use hearsay to settle private scores — I ask that the established rule still be followed."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 維訥領吏、戶二部最久，法制多經裁定。

translations.literal: Weine headed the ministries of Personnel and Revenue longest, and many institutions were settled under his hand.
translations.idiomatic: Weine headed the ministries of Personnel and Revenue longer than any other post, and many regulations were settled under his hand.

sentences.zh: 凡事持大體，遇會議、會推、朝審，委曲斟酌，期於至當。

translations.literal: In everything he upheld the larger principle; at joint conferences, joint recommendation, and court review he weighed matters carefully so as to reach what was right.
translations.idiomatic: In all affairs he held to the larger principle; at joint conferences, joint recommendations, and court reviews he weighed matters with care until he reached what was right.

sentences.zh: 敷奏條暢，所見與眾偶有同異，開陳端緒，不留隱情，上深重之，往往從其言。

translations.literal: His memorials were orderly and lucid; when his view occasionally differed from others', he opened the thread of the matter without concealing anything — the emperor valued him deeply and often followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: His memorials were clear and well ordered; when his view differed from the rest he laid out the beginning of the matter and held nothing back — the emperor valued him deeply and often followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 十九年，遭母憂。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he mourned his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋，詣京師，未補官，卒，諡恭定。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he went to the capital but before reassignment died; posthumous title Gongding.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning was over he went to the capital, but before he could be reassigned to office he died; he was given the posthumous title Gongding.

sentences.zh: 任克溥，字海眉，山東聊城人。

translations.literal: Ren Kepu, styled Haimei, was a native of Liaocheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Kepu, whose courtesy name was Haimei, came from Liaocheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 順治四年進士，授南陽府推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the fourth year of Shunzhi and was appointed magistrate of the judging office of Nanyang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi degree in the fourth year of Shunzhi and was appointed magistrate of the judging office of Nanyang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卓異行取，十三年，授吏科給事中。

translations.literal: Rated outstanding and selected for capital service, in the thirteenth year he was appointed supervising secretary of the Office of Personnel Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Marked outstanding and selected for service at court, in the thirteenth year he was made supervising secretary of the Office of Personnel Affairs.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「上勵精圖治，知親民之官莫過守令，特擇各府繁劇難治者，許三品以上各舉一人，破格任用。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Your Majesty strives to govern with vigor and knows that among officials who are close to the people none surpass prefects and magistrates; therefore you specially chose from each prefecture those that are busy, difficult, and hard to govern, allowing officials of third rank and above each to nominate one person for extraordinary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Your Majesty strives to govern with vigor and knows that among officials close to the people none surpass prefects and magistrates; you therefore singled out the busiest and hardest prefectures and allowed each official of third rank or above to nominate one man for extraordinary appointment.

sentences.zh: 使保舉得當，一人賢則一郡安，人人賢則各省安，太平何難立致。

translations.literal: If nominations are sound, one worthy man means one prefecture at peace; if every man is worthy every province is at peace — how hard is it to attain great tranquility?
translations.idiomatic: If the nominations were sound, one worthy man would bring one prefecture to peace, and if every man were worthy every province would be at peace — how hard could great tranquility be to achieve?

sentences.zh: 乃為時未久，以貪庸劾罷者已有數人，前此保舉不能秉公慎選可知。

translations.literal: Yet in no long time several men nominated this way have already been impeached and dismissed for greed and mediocrity — it is clear that earlier nominations were not made with impartial care in selection.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in a short time several men nominated in this way have already been impeached and dismissed for greed and incompetence — which shows that the earlier nominations were not made with impartial care.

sentences.zh: 乞敕部察處。

translations.literal: I beg an order to the ministry to investigate and deal with this.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the ministry be ordered to investigate and take action.

sentences.zh: 十四年，轉刑科，疏言：「抗糧弊有三：宦戶、儒戶、衙蠹。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he transferred to the Office of Punishments and memorialized: "The abuses of grain-tax resistance have three sources: official households, scholar households, and yamen parasites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he moved to the Office of Punishments and memorialized: "The abuses behind resistance to grain tax have three sources: official households, scholar households, and yamen parasites.

sentences.zh: 宜分三項，各另造冊，申報總督、巡撫、巡按，宦欠者題參，衿欠者褫革，役欠者逮治。

translations.literal: These should be divided into three categories, each with a separate register reported to the governor-general, governor, and touring inspector; official debtors should be impeached by memorial, gentry debtors stripped of status, and runner debtors arrested and punished."
translations.idiomatic: They should be divided into three categories, each with its own register reported to the governor-general, governor, and touring inspector; official debtors should be impeached by memorial, gentry debtors stripped of rank, and runner debtors arrested and punished."

sentences.zh: 」复疏論順天鄉試給事中陸貽吉與同考官李振鄴、張我樸交通行賄鬻舉人，下吏部、都察院嚴鞫，貽吉、振鄴、我樸與居間博士蔡元禧，進士項紹芳，行賄舉人田耜、鄔作霖皆坐斬。

translations.literal: He again memorialized on Shuntian provincial examination supervising secretary Lu Yiji and examiners Li Zhenye and Zhang Wopu trading bribes to sell candidacies; the Ministry of Personnel and Censorate were ordered to interrogate strictly; Lu Yiji, Li Zhenye, Zhang Wopu, the intermediary Doctor of Letters Cai Yuanxi, jinshi Xiang Shaofang, and the bribing candidates Tian Si and Wu Zuolin were all sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized charging that at the Shuntian provincial examination supervising secretary Lu Yiji and fellow examiners Li Zhenye and Zhang Wopu had taken bribes to sell candidacies; the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate were ordered to interrogate them strictly; Lu Yiji, Li Zhenye, Zhang Wopu, the go-between Doctor of Letters Cai Yuanxi, jinshi Xiang Shaofang, and the bribing candidates Tian Si and Wu Zuolin were all sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 命禮部覆試不及程者，褫奪流徙又二十五人，考官庶子曹本榮、中允宋之繩並坐降調。

translations.literal: Those who failed the Ministry of Rites re-examination for incomplete essays had honors stripped and were banished — twenty-five more persons; chief examiner Cao Benrong and associate examiner Song Zhisheng were both demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Those who failed the Ministry of Rites re-examination for substandard essays had their honors stripped and were banished — twenty-five more men; chief examiner Cao Benrong and associate examiner Song Zhisheng were both demoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 十五年，充會試同考官，出闈，疏言：「伏讀上諭，令各衙門條奏興利除弊。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as associate metropolitan examiner; upon leaving the examination hall he memorialized: "I have read Your Majesty's instruction ordering each yamen to memorialize on promoting profit and removing harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he served as associate metropolitan examiner; when he left the examination compound he memorialized: "I have read Your Majesty's instruction ordering every yamen to memorialize on promoting benefit and removing harm.

sentences.zh: 時近兩月，僅見宗人府一疏，各衙門遲疑觀望。

translations.literal: It has been nearly two months and only one memorial from the Court of the Imperial Clan has appeared; every yamen hesitates and watches.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly two months have passed and only one memorial from the Court of the Imperial Clan has appeared; every yamen hesitates and waits.

sentences.zh: 竊謂其病有二：一則因循既久，發論方新，恐無以贖往日曠官之咎；

translations.literal: I think there are two afflictions: one is that long-standing inertia, with discourse just renewed, breeds fear of no way to atone for past dereliction in office;
translations.idiomatic: I think there are two afflictions: one is that after long inertia, with fresh calls for reform, officials fear they cannot atone for past dereliction;

sentences.zh: 一則瞻望多端，指陳無隱，恐無以留後來遷就之門。

translations.literal: the other is manifold hesitation — speak frankly without concealment and one fears no door left for later compromise.
translations.idiomatic: the other is manifold hesitation — speak frankly without concealment and one fears leaving no door for later compromise.

sentences.zh: 臣子報國，止有朴忠，遇事直陳；

translations.literal: A subject's service to the state admits only plain loyalty and speaking straight in affairs;
translations.idiomatic: A subject serves the state only through plain loyalty and speaking straight in affairs;

sentences.zh: 稍一轉念，便持兩端，勢必摭拾瑣屑，剿說雷同，不能慷慨論列，又安望設誠致行？

translations.literal: at the slightest second thought one holds two ends, and inevitably gathers trifles and copies commonplaces, unable to argue boldly in array — how then can one hope to establish sincerity and carry it into action?
translations.idiomatic: at the slightest second thought one wavers, and inevitably gathers trifles and repeats what others say, unable to argue boldly — how then can one hope to establish sincerity and carry it into action?

sentences.zh: 今南服削平，萬方底定，宜總計財賦之數，准其出入，定為經久不易之規。

translations.literal: Now the south has been pacified and all regions settled; the total of fiscal revenue should be reckoned, income and outgo balanced, and a lasting rule fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Now the south has been pacified and the realm settled; the total of fiscal revenue should be reckoned, income and outgo balanced, and a lasting rule established.

sentences.zh: 請通計一歲內畝賦、丁徭、鹽徵、津稅，各省輕齎、重運及贖鍰事例等項，汰其猥瑣無藝者，所存金粟若干數；

translations.literal: I request a comprehensive reckoning within one year of land tax, poll corvée, salt levies, transit duties, light delivery and heavy transport from each province, and fines by precedent — cutting trivial and useless items and stating how much gold and grain remains;
translations.idiomatic: I ask for a comprehensive reckoning within one year of land tax, poll corvée, salt levies, transit duties, light delivery and heavy transport from each province, and fines by precedent — cutting trivial and useless items and stating how much gold and grain remains;

sentences.zh: 然後計一歲內上方供應、官吏俸祿、兵馬糧料、朝祭禮儀、修築工役，以至師生廩餼、胥役代食，罷其不經無益者，所需金粟若干數：務使出入相合，定為會計之準。

translations.literal: then reckon within one year imperial supplies, official salaries, army grain and fodder, court sacrifices and rites, construction labor, down to students' stipends and clerks' rations — abolishing what is irregular and useless and stating how much gold and grain is required: see that income and outgo match and fix this as the standard of accounts.
translations.idiomatic: then reckon within one year imperial supplies, official salaries, army grain and fodder, court sacrifices and rites, construction labor, down to students' stipends and clerks' rations — abolishing what is irregular and useless and stating how much gold and grain is required: see that income and outgo match and fix this as the standard of accounts.

sentences.zh: 用財大端惟兵，生財本計惟土。

translations.literal: The great outlet for expenditure is the army; the fundamental means of producing wealth is land.
translations.idiomatic: The great outlet for expenditure is the army. the fundamental means of producing wealth is land.

sentences.zh: 欲紓國計，莫善於屯田，朝廷下民屯之令。

translations.literal: To relieve the state budget, nothing is better than garrison farming; the court issued orders for civilian colonies.
translations.idiomatic: To relieve the state budget, nothing is better than garrison farming. the court issued orders for civilian colonies.

sentences.zh: 設官置役，多糜廩祿，得不償失，不旋踵而請罷。

translations.literal: Officials and runners were appointed, consuming much grain salary; the gain did not repay the cost, and before long abolition was requested.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and runners were appointed, consuming much grain salary. the gain did not repay the cost, and before long abolition was requested.

sentences.zh: 稽古屯制，不在民而在兵，請敕各省駐兵處所，無論邊腹地方，察有荒土，令兵充種。

translations.literal: Examining ancient garrison-farming systems, they lay not with civilians but with soldiers — I request orders that wherever troops are stationed in each province, whether frontier or interior, if vacant land is found, soldiers be ordered to farm it.
translations.idiomatic: Examining ancient garrison-farming systems, they lay not with civilians but with soldiers — I ask that wherever troops are stationed in each province, whether frontier or interior, if vacant land is found, soldiers be ordered to farm it.

sentences.zh: 正疆界，信賞罰，則趨事自力；

translations.literal: Fix boundaries, keep rewards and punishments credible, and men will exert themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Fix boundaries, keep rewards and punishments credible, while men will exert themselves;

sentences.zh: 豐種具，寬程效，則收穫自充。

translations.literal: provide ample seed and tools, allow generous time for results, and harvests will supply themselves.
translations.idiomatic: provide ample seed and tools, allow generous time for results, while harvests will supply themselves.

sentences.zh: 此唐初府兵之制也。

translations.literal: This is the system of Tang garrison militia at the founding.
translations.idiomatic: This is the system of Tang garrison militia at the founding.

sentences.zh: 自頃四川、貴州已入版圖，所得之地，必需駐守；

translations.literal: Recently Sichuan and Guizhou have entered the map; the lands gained require garrisons;
translations.idiomatic: Recently Sichuan and Guizhou have entered the map. the lands gained require garrisons;

sentences.zh: 若令處處興屯，則根本自固，戰守咸資。

translations.literal: if garrison farming is established everywhere, the foundation will be secure of itself and both offense and defense will be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: if garrison farming is established everywhere, the foundation will be secure of itself and both offense and defense will be supplied.

sentences.zh: 此又趙充國之於先零，杜預之於宛、葉，確然可循之遺策也。

translations.literal: This is also the sure precedent of Zhao Chongguo against the Xianlian and Du Yu at Wan and Ye.
translations.idiomatic: This is also the sure precedent of Zhao Chongguo against the Xianlian and Du Yu at Wan and Ye.

sentences.zh: 順天左右郡縣，拱翊王畿，根本要地，自令舊人圈住，深得居重馭輕之意。

translations.literal: The counties around Shuntian guard the capital — a fundamental region; since the order for old settlers to enclose land, the principle of holding the heavy to control the light has been well applied.
translations.idiomatic: The counties around Shuntian guard the capital — a fundamental region. since the order for old settlers to enclose land, the principle of holding the heavy to control the light has been well applied.

sentences.zh: 但畿輔之民，多失恆業，撥補他地，皆有係屬，豈能據為己有？

translations.literal: But the people of the metropolitan region have largely lost their regular livelihoods; land assigned elsewhere all has prior claims — how can they hold it as their own?
translations.idiomatic: But the people of the metropolitan region have largely lost their regular livelihoods. land assigned elsewhere all has prior claims — how can they hold it as their own?

sentences.zh: 今喜峰、冷口諸關外，大寧以南，彌望千里，咸稱膏壤，請令民原出關開墾者，許承為己業。

translations.literal: Now beyond the passes of Xifeng, Lengkou, and others, south of Daning, for a thousand li in every direction all is called fertile soil — I request that commoners who originally went beyond the passes to open land be allowed to hold it as their own property.
translations.idiomatic: Now beyond the passes of Xifeng, Lengkou, and others, south of Daning, fertile land stretches for a thousand li in every direction — I ask that commoners who originally went beyond the passes to open land be allowed to hold it as their own property.

sentences.zh: 沃土新闢，獲利必饒，先事有獲，趨者自眾。

translations.literal: Newly opened fertile soil yields rich profit; when the first efforts succeed, many will rush to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Newly opened fertile soil yields rich profit. when the first efforts succeed, many will rush to follow.

sentences.zh: 數年以後，漸次起科，成聚成邑，堪資保障。

translations.literal: After several years, taxes may be levied by stages; settlements and towns will form and serve for defense.
translations.idiomatic: After several years, taxes may be levied by stages. settlements and towns will form and serve for defense.

sentences.zh: 二者皆軍國大計，若設誠致行，久之兵食充足，國基賴以不拔矣。

translations.literal: Both are great plans for army and state; if carried out with sincerity, in time army provisions will be ample and the foundation of the realm will rest unshaken."
translations.idiomatic: Both are great plans for army and state. if carried out with sincerity, in time army provisions will be ample and the foundation of the realm will rest unshaken."

sentences.zh: 」下部議，以滇、黔未靖，兵餉無數，難以預定會計；

translations.idiomatic: " The ministry deliberated that Yunnan and Guizhou were not yet pacified, military funds were countless, while accounts could not be fixed in advance;

sentences.zh: 設置兵屯，及畿輔民出邊墾種，敕所司詳勘。

translations.literal: establishment of military colonies and metropolitan commoners going beyond the border to farm were ordered to the relevant offices for detailed survey.
translations.idiomatic: establishment of military colonies and metropolitan commoners going beyond the border to farm were ordered to the relevant offices for detailed survey.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷順天府府丞，再遷左通政。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to vice prefect of Shuntian prefecture, then to left vice commissioner of the Communications Office.
translations.idiomatic: During the seventeenth year he was transferred to vice prefect of Shuntian prefecture, then to left vice commissioner of the Communications Office.

sentences.zh: 十八年，遷太常寺卿。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: During the eighteenth year he was transferred to president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，遷通政使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was transferred to commissioner of the Communications Office.
translations.idiomatic: During the third year of Kangxi he was transferred to commissioner of the Communications Office.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth year he was promoted to vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十年，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During the tenth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十二年，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: During the twelfth year he was transferred to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 官戶部時，甘肅巡撫華善因擅發倉粟賑災，戶部循例題參，並議罰償，鴻儒無異議；

translations.literal: When he was in the Ministry of Revenue, Gansu governor Huashan, for issuing granary grain without authorization to relieve disaster, was impeached by memorial according to precedent and also ordered to pay compensation; Hongru raised no objection;
translations.idiomatic: When he served in the Ministry of Revenue, Gansu governor Huashan, for issuing granary grain without authorization to relieve disaster, was impeached by memorial according to precedent and also ordered to pay compensation; Hongru raised no objection;

sentences.zh: 及官都御史，又疏論華善不應參處，嗣後封疆大臣有利民之政，不宜拘以文法。

translations.literal: when he became censor-in-chief he again memorialized that Huashan should not have been impeached, and that hereafter frontier grandees with policies benefiting the people should not be bound by formal regulations.
translations.idiomatic: when he became censor-in-chief he again memorialized that Huashan should not have been impeached, and that hereafter frontier officials with policies benefiting the people should not be bound by formal regulations.

sentences.zh: 給事成性疏劾，下部議，坐鴻儒先未異議，後又指摘沽名，降二級調用。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Cheng Xing impeached by memorial; referred to the ministry; Hongru was found guilty of first raising no objection and later criticizing for reputation's sake, and was demoted two ranks and reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Cheng Xing impeached him by memorial; referred to the ministry; Hongru was found guilty of first raising no objection and later criticizing for reputation's sake, and was demoted two ranks and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 尋卒於家。

translations.literal: Soon after he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at home.

sentences.zh: 劉楗，字玉罍，直隸大城人。

translations.literal: Liu Jian, styled Yulei, was a native of Dacheng in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian, whose courtesy name was Yulei, came from Dacheng in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 順治二年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the second year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi degree in the second year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 是歲選新進士十人授給事中，楗除戶科。

translations.literal: That year ten new jinshi were selected and appointed supervising secretaries; Jian was assigned to the Office of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: That year ten new jinshi were selected and appointed supervising secretaries. Jian was assigned to the Office of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疏論山東巡撫楊聲遠劾青州道韓昭宣受賄釋叛賊十四人，僅令住俸勦賊，罰不蔽辜，昭宣坐奪官。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Shandong governor Yang Shengyuan had impeached Qingzhou circuit intendant Han Zhaoxuan for taking bribes and releasing fourteen rebel bandits, yet only ordered suspension of salary while pursuing bandits — punishment did not cover the crime — and Zhaoxuan was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Shandong governor Yang Shengyuan had impeached Qingzhou circuit intendant Han Zhaoxuan for taking bribes and releasing fourteen rebel bandits, yet only ordered suspension of salary while pursuing bandits — the punishment did not fit the crime — and Zhaoxuan was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 四年，轉兵科右給事中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he transferred to right supervising secretary of the Office of War.
translations.idiomatic: During the fourth year he transferred to right supervising secretary of the Office of War.

sentences.zh: 疏論江南巡按宋調元薦舉泰州游擊潘延吉，寇至棄城走，調元濫舉失當，亦坐奪官。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Jiangnan touring inspector Song Diaoyuan had recommended Taizhou regional commander Pan Yanji, who abandoned the city and fled when bandits came — Diaoyuan's indiscriminate recommendation was improper and he too was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Jiangnan touring inspector Song Diaoyuan had recommended Taizhou regional commander Pan Yanji, who abandoned the city and fled when bandits came — Diaoyuan's indiscriminate recommendation was improper and he too was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 是歲大計，楗用拾遺例，揭山東聊城知縣張守廉贓款，下所司勘議，守廉以失察吏役得贓，罰俸；

translations.literal: That year at the grand evaluation Jian used the omission-report precedent to expose Shandong Liaocheng magistrate Zhang Shoulian's embezzled funds; referred for investigation; Shoulian was fined salary for failure to supervise clerks who took bribes;
translations.idiomatic: That year at the grand evaluation Jian used the omission-report precedent to expose Shandong Liaocheng magistrate Zhang Shoulian's embezzled funds. referred for investigation. Shoulian was fined salary for failure to supervise clerks who took bribes;

sentences.zh: 楗誣糾，坐奪官。

translations.literal: Jian was found to have impeached falsely and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Jian was found to have impeached falsely and was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 十年，吏科都給事中魏象樞請行大計拾遺，因論楗枉，得旨，吏役詐贓，知縣僅罰俸，言官反坐奪官，明有冤抑，令吏部察奏，命以原官起用。

translations.literal: In the tenth year chief supervising secretary of the Office of Personnel Wei Xiangshu requested omission reports at the grand evaluation and argued that Jian had been wronged; receiving an edict that clerks had fraudulently taken bribes while the magistrate was only fined salary yet the remonstrance official was stripped — clear injustice — the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to investigate and report; Jian was ordered reappointed to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year chief supervising secretary of the Office of Personnel Wei Xiangshu requested omission reports at the grand evaluation and argued that Jian had been wronged. receiving an edict that clerks had fraudulently taken bribes while the magistrate was only fined salary yet the remonstrance official was stripped — clear injustice — the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to investigate and report. Jian was ordered reappointed to his former post.

sentences.zh: 授兵科左給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed left supervising secretary of the Office of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed left supervising secretary of the Office of War.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「近畿被水地，水落地可耕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "In the metropolitan region, flooded land — when the water recedes the land can be farmed.
translations.idiomatic: During the eleventh year he memorialized: "In the metropolitan region, flooded land — when the water recedes the land can be farmed.

sentences.zh: 方春農事急，請敕巡撫檄州縣發存留銀，借災民籽種，俟秋成責償。

translations.literal: Spring farming is urgent; I request orders to the governor to instruct prefectures and counties to disburse retained silver, lend seed to disaster victims, and require repayment after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Spring farming is urgent; I ask that the governor be ordered to instruct prefectures and counties to disburse retained silver, lend seed to disaster victims, and require repayment after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 仍飭巡行鄉村勘覈，不使吏胥得緣以為利。

translations.literal: Also order tours of villages for verification so that clerks may not profit by the occasion."
translations.idiomatic: Also order tours of villages for verification so that clerks may not profit by the occasion."

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he memorialized: "Zheng Chenggong ravages Zhangzhou and Quanzhou and watches the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the twelfth year he memorialized: "Zheng Chenggong ravages Zhangzhou and Quanzhou and watches the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 臣昔充福建考官，詢悉地勢。

translations.literal: Your servant once served as examiner in Fujian and inquired into the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: I once served as examiner in Fujian and inquired into the terrain.

sentences.zh: 福清鎮東衛，明時駐兵防倭。

translations.literal: At Fuqing, Zhendong garrison — in the Ming troops were stationed there against Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuqing, Zhendong garrison — in the Ming troops were stationed there against Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 倘復舊制，可以保障長樂，籓衛會城。

translations.literal: If the old system is restored, it can secure Changle and guard the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: If the old system is restored, it can secure Changle and guard the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 宋、元設州海壇，明以倭患棄之。

translations.literal: Under Song and Yuan a prefecture was set at Haitan; the Ming abandoned it because of Japanese raids.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song and Yuan a prefecture was set at Haitan. the Ming abandoned it because of Japanese raids.

sentences.zh: 若設將鎮守，可與鎮東互為犄角。

translations.literal: If a general is posted to garrison it, it can form a pincer with Zhendong.
translations.idiomatic: If a general is posted to garrison it, it can form a pincer with Zhendong.

sentences.zh: 仙霞嶺為入福建門戶，與江西、浙江接壤，宜設官控制，招民以實其地，俾無隙可乘。

translations.literal: Xianxia Ridge is the gateway into Fujian, bordering Jiangxi and Zhejiang; officials should be posted to control it and settlers recruited to fill the land so that no opening is left.
translations.idiomatic: Xianxia Ridge is the gateway into Fujian, bordering Jiangxi and Zhejiang. officials should be posted to control it and settlers recruited to fill the land so that no opening is left.

sentences.zh: 成功數犯京口，泊舟平洋沙為巢穴。

translations.literal: Chenggong has repeatedly raided Jingkou and moors his boats at Pingyang Shoal as a nest.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong has repeatedly raided Jingkou and moors his boats at Pingyang Shoal as a nest.

sentences.zh: 宜乘其未至，移兵駐鎮，使退無可據，必不敢深入內地。

translations.literal: Troops should be moved to garrison there before he arrives, so that on retreat he has nothing to hold and will not dare penetrate the interior."
translations.idiomatic: Troops should be moved to garrison there before he arrives, so that on retreat he has nothing to hold and will not dare penetrate the interior."

sentences.zh: 」疏入，敕鎮海將軍石廷柱等分別駐守。

translations.literal: " When the memorial entered, an edict ordered Coastal Defense General Shi Tingzhu and others to garrison separately.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was received, an edict ordered Coastal Defense General Shi Tingzhu and others to garrison separately.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授山西河東道副使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed vice commissioner of the Hedong circuit in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the thirteenth year he was appointed vice commissioner of the Hedong circuit in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 十五年，轉河南鹽驛道參議。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he transferred to commissioner of the salt and postal circuit in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: During the fifteenth year he transferred to commissioner of the salt and postal circuit in Henan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授湖廣按察使，就遷右布政。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed provincial judge of Huguang and soon promoted to right provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixteenth year he was appointed provincial judge of Huguang and soon promoted to right provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，總督張長庚、巡撫楊茂勳疏薦楗廉幹，協濟滇、黔兵餉至八百餘萬，清逋賦墾地，除鼓鑄積弊。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Governor-General Zhang Changgeng and Governor Yang Maoxun memorialized recommending Jian as honest and capable; he assisted in supplying more than eight million in military funds for Yunnan and Guizhou, cleared tax arrears, opened wasteland, and removed long-standing abuses in coin casting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Governor-General Zhang Changgeng and Governor Yang Maoxun memorialized recommending Jian as honest and capable. he assisted in supplying more than eight million in military funds for Yunnan and Guizhou, cleared tax arrears, opened wasteland, and removed long-standing abuses in coin casting.

sentences.zh: 楗以母憂歸。

translations.literal: Jian returned home in mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Jian returned home to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，起江西布政使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi he was recalled as provincial administration commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the second year of Kangxi he was recalled as provincial administration commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂亂作，措餉供兵，事辦而民不擾。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui's rebellion broke out, he arranged funds and supplied the army; affairs were handled and the people were not disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Sangui's rebellion broke out, he arranged funds and supplied the army; affairs were handled and the people were not disturbed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授太常寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: During the fourteenth year he was appointed president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷大理寺卿。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to president of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixteenth year he was transferred to president of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢副都御史，疏言：「自吳三桂為亂，軍需旁午，大計暫停。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and memorialized: "Since Wu Sangui's rebellion, military needs have crowded in every direction and the grand evaluation has been suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and memorialized: "Since Wu Sangui's rebellion, military needs have crowded in from every direction and the grand evaluation has been suspended.

sentences.zh: 今師所至，漸次蕩平。

translations.literal: Now wherever the army goes, regions are gradually pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Now wherever the army goes, regions are gradually pacified.

sentences.zh: 伏思兵後殘壞已極，正賴賢有司招徠安輯。

translations.literal: I reflect that after war ruin is at its extreme and we rely on worthy local officials to recruit settlers and restore peace.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that after war ruin is at its extreme and we rely on worthy local officials to recruit settlers and restore peace.

sentences.zh: 若使不肖用事，何以澄吏治、奠民生、息盜賊？

translations.literal: If unworthy men hold office, how can official discipline be clarified, the people's livelihood settled, and bandits stilled?
translations.idiomatic: If unworthy men hold office, how can official discipline be clarified, the people's livelihood settled, while bandits stilled?

sentences.zh: 請令督撫速行舉劾，凡經薦舉者，改行易操，一體嚴察，不得偏徇。

translations.literal: I request orders to governors-general and governors to proceed quickly with impeachment and recommendation; all who have been recommended, whether their conduct has changed or not, should be strictly examined alike without partiality."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors be ordered to proceed quickly with impeachment and recommendation; all who have been recommended, whether their conduct has changed or not, should be strictly examined alike without partiality."

sentences.zh: 」下部如所請行。

translations.literal: " The ministry acted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry acted as requested.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「江西當亂後，民逃田墟，錢糧缺額不急予蠲免，逃者不歸，歸者復逃；

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "After the rebellion in Jiangxi, the people fled and fields lay waste; if tax shortfalls are not promptly remitted, those who fled will not return and those who return will flee again;
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial: "After the rebellion in Jiangxi, the people fled and fields lay waste; if tax shortfalls are not promptly remitted, those who fled will not return and those who return will flee again;

sentences.zh: 荒者未墾，墾者仍荒​​。

translations.literal: wasteland remains unopened and opened land falls waste again."
translations.idiomatic: wasteland remains unopened and opened land falls waste again."

sentences.zh: 」上為特旨悉行蠲免。

translations.literal: " The emperor issued a special edict granting full remission.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor issued a special edict granting full remission.

sentences.zh: 旋以病乞休，諭慰留，遣太醫視疾。

translations.literal: Soon after he requested retirement on grounds of illness; the emperor comforted him and kept him in office, sending an imperial physician to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he requested retirement on grounds of illness. the emperor comforted him and kept him in office, sending an imperial physician to attend him.

sentences.zh: 擢吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 未幾，复擢刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Before long he was again promoted to minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was again promoted to minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 十八年，病劇，始得請還裡。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year his illness grew severe and he was at last permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: During the eighteenth year his illness grew severe and he was at last permitted to return home.

sentences.zh: 至家，卒，賜祭葬，諡端敏。

translations.literal: Upon reaching home he died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, posthumous title Duanmin.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching home he died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, and he was given the posthumous title Duanmin.

sentences.zh: 硃裴，字小晉，山西聞喜人。

translations.literal: Zhu Pei, styled Xiaojin, was a native of Wenxi in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Pei, whose courtesy name was Xiaojin, came from Wenxi in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 亦順治三年進士。

translations.literal: He also passed the jinshi in the third year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He also took his jinshi degree in the third year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 知直隸易州，移河南禹州。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Yizhou in Zhili and was transferred to Yuzhou in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Yizhou in Zhili and was transferred to Yuzhou in Henan.

sentences.zh: 裴治尚嚴，到官即捕殺盜渠。

translations.literal: Pei's governance favored severity; upon taking office he at once captured and executed bandit chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Pei governed with severity; upon taking office he at once captured and executed bandit chiefs.

sentences.zh: 縣有諸生聘婦為盜掠，既復自歸。

translations.literal: In the county a scholar's betrothed was seized by bandits but later returned of her own accord.
translations.idiomatic: During the county a scholar's betrothed was seized by bandits but later returned of her own accord.

sentences.zh: 盜以奪婦訟生，婦以生貧且別娶，反為盜證。

translations.literal: The bandit sued the scholar for taking back the woman; the woman, citing the scholar's poverty and another marriage, testified for the bandit instead.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit sued the scholar for taking back the woman. the woman, citing the scholar's poverty and another marriage, testified for the bandit instead.

sentences.zh: 前政論生死，裴廉得實，為榜殺婦而出生於獄。

translations.literal: The previous administration debated life and death; Pei investigated impartially and found the truth, had the woman executed by public notice and released the scholar from prison.
translations.idiomatic: The previous administration debated life and death. Pei investigated impartially and found the truth, had the woman executed by public notice and released the scholar from prison.

sentences.zh: 擢刑部員外郎，遷廣東道御史，再遷禮科給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, transferred to censor of the Guangdong circuit, and again to supervising secretary of the Office of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, transferred to censor of the Guangdong circuit, while again to supervising secretary of the Office of Rites.

sentences.zh: 滿洲俗尚殉葬，裴疏請申禁，略言：「泥信幽明，未有如此之甚者。

translations.literal: Manchu custom favored following the dead in burial; Pei memorialized requesting strict prohibition, saying in part: "To be mired in belief in the nether world — never has there been anything so extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu custom favored following the dead in burial. Pei memorialized requesting strict prohibition, saying in part: "To be mired in belief in the nether world — never has there been anything so extreme.

sentences.zh: 夫以主命責問奴僕，或畏威而不敢不從，或懷德而不忍不從，二者俱不可為訓。

translations.literal: When the master's command compels servants, some obey from fear of authority and dare not refuse, others from gratitude and cannot bear to refuse — neither can serve as instruction.
translations.idiomatic: After the master's command compels servants, some obey from fear of authority and dare not refuse, others from gratitude and cannot bear to refuse — neither can serve as instruction.

sentences.zh: 好生惡死，人之常情。

translations.literal: Love of life and hatred of death are the common feelings of mankind.
translations.idiomatic: Love of life and hatred of death are the common feelings of mankind.

sentences.zh: 捐軀輕生，非盛世所宜有。

translations.literal: To cast away the body and treat life lightly is not what a flourishing age should have."
translations.idiomatic: To cast away the body and treat life lightly is not what a flourishing age should have."

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報可。

translations.literal: " When the memorial entered, approval was reported.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was received, approval was reported.

sentences.zh: 累遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 以疾乞休，歸。

translations.literal: He requested retirement on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 地震，傷於足，臥家九年，卒。

translations.literal: An earthquake injured his foot; he lay at home nine years and died.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake injured his foot. he lay at home nine years and died.

sentences.zh: 張廷樞，字景峰，陝西韓城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingshu, styled Jingfeng, was a native of Hancheng in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingshu, whose courtesy name was Jingfeng, came from Hancheng in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 父顧行，康熙六年進士，官江安督糧道。

translations.literal: His father Gu Xing passed the jinshi in the sixth year of Kangxi and served as grain-supervision commissioner of Jiang'an.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gu Xing took his jinshi degree in the sixth year of Kangxi and served as grain-supervision commissioner of Jiang'an.

sentences.zh: 廷樞，二十一年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Tingshu passed the jinshi in the twenty-first year, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu took his jinshi degree in the twenty-first year, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，以侍讀主江南鄉試。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, as reader-in-waiting, he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: During the thirty-eighth year, as reader-in-waiting, he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，以內閣學士督江南學政。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, as grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat, he supervised education in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: During the forty-first year, as grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat, he supervised education in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，聖祖南巡，賜御書、冠服。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, when the Sage Ancestor made his southern tour, imperial calligraphy and court dress were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, when the Kangxi emperor made his southern tour, imperial calligraphy and court dress were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，遷吏部侍郎，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was transferred to vice minister of personnel and served as lecturer at the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the forty-fifth year he was transferred to vice minister of personnel and served as lecturer at the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 湖廣容美土司田舜年揭其子昺如貪庸暴戾，昺如匿桑植土司向長庚所，不赴鞫。

translations.literal: Huguang native-official Tian Shunian of Rongmei exposed his son Bingru as greedy, mediocre, and violent; Bingru hid with Xiang Changgeng, native-official of Sangzhi, and did not appear for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang native-official Tian Shunian of Rongmei exposed his son Bingru as greedy, incompetent, and violent; Bingru hid with Xiang Changgeng, native-official of Sangzhi, and did not appear for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 總督石文晟以聞，並劾舜年僭妄。

translations.literal: Governor-General Shi Wencheng reported this and also impeached Shunian for presumption.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Shi Wencheng reported this and also impeached Shunian for presumption.

sentences.zh: 命左都御史梅鋗、內閣學士二格會文晟按治。

translations.literal: Left censor-in-chief Mei Juan and Grand Secretariat academician Erge were ordered to join Wencheng in investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Left censor-in-chief Mei Juan and Grand Secretariat academician Erge were ordered to join Wencheng in investigation.

sentences.zh: 舜年詣武昌，文晟執之，病卒。

translations.literal: Shunian went to Wuchang; Wencheng detained him and he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Shunian went to Wuchang. Wencheng detained him and he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 鋗與文晟各具議疏陳，二格疏言佐證未集，未可即定議。

translations.literal: Juan and Wencheng each memorialized with their views; Erge memorialized that corroboration was not yet assembled and a decision could not yet be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Juan and Wencheng each memorialized with their views; Erge memorialized that corroboration was not yet assembled and a decision could not yet be fixed.

sentences.zh: 詔廷樞偕大學士席哈納、侍郎蕭永藻覆勘，舜年各款俱虛，梅鋗以草率具奏，下部議奪官；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Tingshu together with Grand Secretary Xi Hana and vice minister Xiao Yongzao to reinvestigate; every charge against Shunian proved false; Mei Juan was referred to the ministry for stripping office for hasty memorializing;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Tingshu together with Grand Secretary Xi Hana and vice minister Xiao Yongzao to reinvestigate. every charge against Shunian proved false. Mei Juan was referred to the ministry for stripping office for hasty memorializing;

sentences.zh: 文晟及湖北巡撫劉殿衡、偏沅巡撫趙申喬、提督俞益謨各降罰有差。

translations.literal: Wencheng, Huguang governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Wencheng, Huguang governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, while provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，進刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was advanced to minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: During the forty-eighth year he was advanced to minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 民張三等盜倉米，步軍統領託合齊逮送刑部，滿尚書齊世武擬斬監候，廷樞持不可，擬充軍。

translations.literal: Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice; Steppe Army commander Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments; Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment; Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.
translations.idiomatic: Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice. Steppe Army commander Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments. Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment. Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.

sentences.zh: 下九卿議，廷樞改擬不當，當罰俸。

translations.literal: Referred to the Nine Ministers for discussion; Tingshu's revised proposal was deemed improper and he was fined salary.
translations.idiomatic: Referred to the Nine Ministers for discussion. Tingshu's revised proposal was deemed improper and he was fined salary.

sentences.zh: 上責廷樞偏執好勝，奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Tingshu for obstinacy and love of winning and stripped his office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Tingshu for obstinacy and love of winning and stripped his office.

sentences.zh: 俄，託合齊得罪，五十一年，起廷樞工部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon Tuoheqi fell from favor; in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tuoheqi fell from favor. in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 江南總督噶禮、江蘇巡撫張伯行互訐，命尚書張鵬翮、總督赫壽按治，議奪伯行官。

translations.literal: Jiangnan governor-general Gali and Jiangsu governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other; ministers Zhang Penghe and Governor-General Heshou were ordered to investigate; Boxing's office was proposed for stripping.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan governor-general Gali and Jiangsu governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other. ministers Zhang Penghe and Governor-General Heshou were ordered to investigate. Boxing's office was proposed for stripping.

sentences.zh: 上復命廷樞與尚書穆和倫覆勘，如鵬翮等議。

translations.literal: The emperor again ordered Tingshu and minister Mu Helun to reinvestigate; they followed Penghe's recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again ordered Tingshu and minister Mu Helun to reinvestigate. they followed Penghe's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 疏下九卿，上特命奪噶禮官，伯行復任。

translations.literal: The memorial went to the Nine Ministers; the emperor specially ordered Gali stripped of office and Boxing restored.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Nine Ministers. the emperor specially ordered Gali stripped of office and Boxing restored.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: During the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，河南宜陽知縣張育徽加徵火耗虐民，盜渠亢珽結澠池盜李一臨據神垕寨為亂，並劫永寧知縣高式青入寨；

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year Yiyang magistrate Zhang Yuhui of Henan imposed surcharges on silver and oppressed the people; bandit chief Kang Ting joined Mianchi bandit Li Yilin in occupying Shenhou Stockade in rebellion and also seized Yongning magistrate Gao Shiqing into the stockade;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year Yiyang magistrate Zhang Yuhui of Henan imposed surcharges on silver and oppressed the people. bandit chief Kang Ting joined Mianchi bandit Li Yilin in occupying Shenhou Stockade in rebellion and also seized Yongning magistrate Gao Shiqing into the stockade;

sentences.zh: 閿鄉盜王更一亦藉知縣白澄豫徵錢糧，嘯聚圍縣城；

translations.literal: Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi also relied on magistrate Bai Cheng's advance collection of taxes and grain, gathered followers, and besieged the county seat;
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi also relied on magistrate Bai Cheng's advance collection of taxes and grain, gathered followers, while besieged the county seat;

sentences.zh: 巡撫張聖佐、總兵馮君侁不能平，又匿不以起釁所由入告。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Shengduo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Shengduo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.

sentences.zh: 命廷樞與內閣學士勒什布按治，珽自縊；

translations.literal: Tingshu and Grand Secretariat academician Leshibu were ordered to investigate; Ting hanged himself;
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu and Grand Secretariat academician Leshibu were ordered to investigate. Ting hanged himself;

sentences.zh: 更一、一臨就擒，置之法；

translations.literal: Gengyi and Yilin were captured and punished by law;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyi and Yilin were captured and punished by law;

sentences.zh: 澄、育徽擬絞監候；

translations.literal: Cheng and Yuhui were proposed for strangulation after imprisonment;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng and Yuhui were proposed for strangulation after imprisonment;

sentences.zh: 聖佐、君侁奪官；

translations.literal: Shengduo and Junqian were stripped of office;
translations.idiomatic: Shengduo and Junqian were stripped of office;

sentences.zh: 並追咎原任巡撫李錫令屬吏加徵激變，論斬。

translations.literal: and former governor Li Xiling was also held accountable for subordinates' added levies provoking rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: and former governor Li Xiling was also held accountable for subordinates' added levies provoking rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 蘭陽白蓮教首袁進等謀不軌，命廷樞並按，論罪如律。

translations.literal: Lanyang White Lotus sect leader Yuan Jin and others plotted sedition; Tingshu was ordered to investigate jointly and sentence according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Lanyang White Lotus sect leader Yuan Jin and others plotted sedition. Tingshu was ordered to investigate jointly and sentence according to law.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，南陽鎮兵為亂，辱知府沈淵，命廷樞偕內閣學士高其倬按治；

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year Nanyang garrison troops mutinied and insulted prefect Shen Yuan; Tingshu was ordered with Grand Secretariat academician Gao Qizhuo to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year Nanyang garrison troops mutinied and insulted prefect Shen Yuan. Tingshu was ordered with Grand Secretariat academician Gao Qizhuo to investigate;

sentences.zh: 浙江巡鹽御史哈爾金受商人賕，被劾，命廷樞偕內閣學士德音按治。

translations.literal: Zhejiang salt-censor Haerjin took bribes from merchants and was impeached; Tingshu was ordered with Grand Secretariat academician Deyin to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang salt-censor Haerjin took bribes from merchants and was impeached. Tingshu was ordered with Grand Secretariat academician Deyin to investigate.

sentences.zh: 並論如法。

translations.literal: In both cases sentence followed the law.
translations.idiomatic: In both cases sentence followed the law.

sentences.zh: 廷樞還京師，疏言：「河南漕米自康熙十四年每石改折銀八錢解部，嗣因米賤，部議以一錢五分解部，餘交巡撫購米起運。

translations.literal: When Tingshu returned to the capital he memorialized: "Henan tribute grain since the fourteenth year of Kangxi was converted to eight qian of silver per shi paid to the ministry; later because grain was cheap, the ministry ruled one qian five fen to the ministry and the rest to the governor to purchase grain for transport.
translations.idiomatic: After Tingshu returned to the capital he memorialized: "Henan tribute grain since the fourteenth year of Kangxi was converted to eight qian of silver per shi paid to the ministry; later because grain was cheap, the ministry ruled one qian five fen to the ministry and the rest to the governor to purchase grain for transport.

sentences.zh: 巡撫分委州縣，州縣复派民買輸，甚為閭閻累。

translations.literal: The governor delegated to prefectures and counties, and prefectures and counties again pressed the people to buy and deliver — a great burden on neighborhoods.
translations.idiomatic: The governor delegated to prefectures and counties, while prefectures and counties again pressed the people to buy and deliver — a great burden on neighborhoods.

sentences.zh: 請交糧道購運，毋得派累民間。

translations.literal: I request that purchase and transport be entrusted to the grain circuit and not shifted onto the people."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that purchase and transport be entrusted to the grain circuit and not shifted onto the people."

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " Referred to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " Referred to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 世宗在籓邸，優徐采嗾傭者箠殺人，部議以傭抵。

translations.literal: When the Shizong emperor was at his princely residence, actor Xu Cai incited a hired man to beat someone to death; the ministry proposed the hired man bear the penalty.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng emperor was at his princely residence, actor Xu Cai incited a hired man to beat someone to death; the ministry proposed the hired man bear the penalty.

sentences.zh: 廷樞獨議罪在採，坐徙邊。

translations.literal: Tingshu alone held that guilt lay with Cai and sentenced him to exile on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu alone held that guilt lay with Cai and sentenced him to exile on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，褒廷樞抗直，复逮採論罪。

translations.literal: When the Shizong emperor took the throne he praised Tingshu's forthright resistance and again arrested Cai for sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng emperor took the throne he praised Tingshu's forthright resistance and again arrested Cai for sentencing.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，以原任編修陳夢雷侍誠郡王得罪，命發黑龍江，廷樞循故事，方冬停遣，又出其子使治裝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, former compiler Chen Menglei, who had served the Prince of Cheng and thereby offended, was ordered sent to Heilongjiang; Tingshu followed precedent — deportation halts in winter — and also released his son to prepare baggage.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, former compiler Chen Menglei, who had served the Prince of Cheng and thereby offended, was ordered sent to Heilongjiang. Tingshu followed precedent — deportation halts in winter — and also released his son to prepare baggage.

sentences.zh: 尚書隆科多劾廷樞徇縱，命鐫五級，逐回籍。

translations.literal: Minister Longkodo impeached Tingshu for favoritism and leniency; he was ordered demoted five ranks and expelled to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Longkodo impeached Tingshu for favoritism and leniency. he was ordered demoted five ranks and expelled to his native place.

sentences.zh: 子縉，進士，官中允，亦以告病家居。

translations.literal: His son Jin passed the jinshi, served as palace aide, and also retired home on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jin passed the jinshi, served as palace aide, while also retired home on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 六年，陝西巡撫西琳劾廷樞受河督趙世顯贓六千，抗追不納，縉居鄉不法。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Shaanxi governor Xilin impeached Tingshu for receiving six thousand in bribes from river commissioner Zhao Shixian and resisting recovery without payment; Jin also behaved unlawfully at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Shaanxi governor Xilin impeached Tingshu for receiving six thousand in bribes from river commissioner Zhao Shixian and resisting recovery without payment. Jin also behaved unlawfully at home.

sentences.zh: 詔奪廷樞及縉官，令所司嚴訊。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Tingshu and Jin of office and ordered strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Tingshu and Jin of office and ordered strict interrogation.

sentences.zh: 廷樞被逮，道卒。

translations.literal: Tingshu was arrested and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu was arrested and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 總督岳鍾琪議縉當斬，籍其家，詔特寬免，令縉在川、陝沿邊修城贖罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi proposed Jin be decapitated and his property confiscated; a special edict granted leniency and ordered Jin to atone by repairing walls along the Sichuan and Shaanxi border.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi proposed Jin be decapitated and his property confiscated. a special edict granted leniency and ordered Jin to atone by repairing walls along the Sichuan and Shaanxi border.

sentences.zh: 乾隆時，复廷樞官，追諡文端。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign Tingshu's office was restored and the posthumous title Wenduan was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign Tingshu's office was restored and the posthumous title Wenduan was conferred.

sentences.zh: 子綖，亦進士，官戶部主事。

translations.literal: His son Xuan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xuan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 論曰：維訥論貪吏遇赦，不得遽复官；

translations.literal: The commentators say: Weine argued that corrupt officials who receive pardon must not immediately recover office;
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Weine argued that corrupt officials who receive pardon must not immediately recover office;

sentences.zh: 克溥言民生疾苦，戒加賦濫刑；

translations.literal: Kepu spoke of the people's hardships and warned against added levies and abusive punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Kepu spoke of the people's hardships and warned against added levies and abusive punishment;

sentences.zh: 鴻儒請定歲會之制；

translations.literal: Hongru requested fixing the system of annual accounts;
translations.idiomatic: Hongru requested fixing the system of annual accounts;

sentences.zh: 楗議兵後當復行計典；

translations.literal: Jian urged that after war the grand evaluation should be resumed;
translations.idiomatic: Jian urged that after war the grand evaluation should be resumed;

sentences.zh: 裴請禁殉葬：益於國，澤於民，言各有所當也。

translations.literal: Pei requested prohibition of following the dead in burial — benefit to the state and grace to the people; each spoke to what was fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Pei requested prohibition of following the dead in burial — benefit to the state and grace to the people. each spoke to what was fitting.

sentences.zh: 廷樞使車四出，惟張伯行事出上裁，他皆稱指。

translations.literal: Tingshu sent investigating commissioners in all directions; only the Zhang Boxing affair was decided by the emperor's own judgment — the rest all followed instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu sent investigating commissioners in all directions. only the Zhang Boxing affair was decided by the emperor's own judgment — the rest all followed instructions.

sentences.zh: 律嚴科場罪，所以重取士，乃草野私議輒以為過甚。

translations.literal: The law is strict on examination-hall crimes to honor selection of scholars, yet private talk in the countryside often deems it excessive.
translations.idiomatic: The law is strict on examination-hall crimes to honor selection of scholars, yet private talk in the countryside often deems it excessive.

sentences.zh: 克溥興丁酉順天之獄，卒以不謹罷，殆怨家所中歟？

translations.literal: Kepu stirred the Dingyou Shuntian examination case and in the end was dismissed for lack of care — was he perhaps struck down by enemies?
translations.idiomatic: Kepu stirred the Dingyou Shuntian examination case and in the end was dismissed for lack of care — was he perhaps struck down by enemies?

sentences.zh: 廷樞得罪，似亦有齮之者，詘而後申，足為謇直者勸矣。

translations.literal: Tingshu's fall from favor also seems to have had detractors; humbled and later vindicated, he is enough to encourage the forthright.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu's fall from favor also seems to have had detractors. humbled and later vindicated, he is enough to encourage the forthright.
